|Darting predator that clings fast to roofs and outcrops, often summoned to aid its larger companions.<hr/>They would make effective hunting companions, though even without the Haunting I suspect their loyalty would always remain to their clan.

<b>Skarrwings</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are flying [[Skarr]] that hang on ceilings and wait to ambush intruders.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skarrwings are initially found clinging to ceilings or flying in place when idle.<br>
They take flight once Hornet draws near and pursue her through the air, performing a short aerial dash towards her once they are within range.

Due to their unusual flying pattern, often hovering just slightly above Hornet's basic attack, maintaining distance and quickly turning around to strike before retreating and repeating can prove all that is needed to dispatch them.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* For her! For her!
* Away... toward...
* Find it... take it...
* Strong together! Strong forever!
}}

== Location ==
Skarrwings can be found primarily in [[Hunter's March]], but they also appear in the upper [[Deep Docks]] and as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 4|gauntlet]] in [[Halfway Home]]'s cellar.

After clearing the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Hunter's March 3|gauntlet]] in the eastern part of Hunter's March, a Skarrwing appears alongside a [[Skarr Scout]] upon revisiting the arena before [[Act 3]].
